noun_definition: Page header refers to the visual element at the top of the Workspaces page that should adopt the illustrated header style consistent with other sections in Settings.

Empty state refers to the visual representation displayed on the Workspaces page when no workspaces have been created, specifically indicating the action to "Create a new workspace" using an h1 header.

Workspaces page refers to the section within the application where users can manage their workspaces, specifically accessed through Settings > Workspaces, and is expected to have a consistent header style and an updated empty state presentation.
